text:
First version scope: a read-only list of agents working in this checkout, showing harness, state, name, subdirectory and time since last activity. No transcripts, and no sending to agents.

Constraints:
- Scan only while a page is open, and well below the 2 second default of `watcher.Run`. One warm scan took about 200 ms and allocated about 35 MB, it covers every agent on the machine, and several devhost instances can run at once.
- The agent-watcher scan needs filtering to the checkout, including subdirectories. Exclude nothing the list should show: sessions devhost owns appear too, marked as such.
- Claude Code state comes from session `status`; unknown values show as running, state unknown.
- Live activity and transcripts are tracked separately in DEVHO-e5515cec.
